# Public-adapter fixture license

The files in this directory are original, synthetic, schema-shaped test data
authored for IntuitionMap. They contain no copied benchmark records and no
personal data.

To the extent possible under law, the fixture author dedicates these files to
the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

The fixtures exercise only adapter plumbing. They do not reproduce the
semantics, difficulty, distribution, or evaluation value of LongMemEval,
PersonalLLM, or ATOMIC 2020.
